rubric: Called trivial, but it changes the auth model of an endpoint: far more than an in-place fix.

criteria.scope: the change touches behaviour: fix and have the verifier review the delta | the plan itself is wrong: back to the planner with the thread

reading.why: The reviewer calls the change trivial and in place, which is data. Switching the export endpoint from sessions to signed URLs changes the auth model: far more than a local fix, so the verifier has to review it or the plan is wrong.
